preconditions.description: The number of employees is between 1 and 2000, inclusive.
Each pi denotes the immediate manager for the i-th employee, where pi is either an employee number or -1 if the employee has no immediate manager.
No employee will be the immediate manager of themselves.

preconditions.expression: There will be no managerial cycles
preconditions.description: There will not exist an employee who is the superior of his/her own immediate manager.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of groups is at least 1.
The minimum number of groups is at most n.

postconditions.expression: Every employee must belong to exactly one group.
postconditions.description: Within any single group, there must not be two employees A and B such that A is the superior of B.

postconditions.expression: For every employee, if they have no immediate manager, they form their own group.
postconditions.description: If an employee has no immediate manager (pi = -1), they form their own group.

postconditions.expression: For every employee, if their immediate manager is not their superior, they are in the same group as their immediate manager.
postconditions.description: If an employee has an immediate manager and the immediate manager is not their superior, they are in the same group as their immediate manager.
